system.description:
Lore: Relic Horn

Blowing it is always louder than anyone expects, including the person blowing it. It has the following Powers:

  • Thunderblast: Blow the horn to deal 5d6 damage in a Far Cone; those who fail [Endure] are also Dazed. On a roll of 1-4 on a d100, the horn explodes and is destroyed, dealing 10d6 to the user.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
